issues.explanation: Register validates via a protected rules() method instead of the project's #[Validate] attribute pattern used by Login.
Password reset validates three fields inline instead of a Form Request once rules grow beyond two fields.

conventions.evidence: Login uses #[Validate('required|string|email:rfc,strict|max:255)'] at app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:235 and $this->validate(); views use route() e.g. resources/views/livewire/auth/login.blade.php:853 and actions use redirect()->route() e.g. app/Http/Controllers/LogoutController.php:128 with plain wire:model="email"; deviation: app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:369 uses protected rules() with no #[Validate] attributes

readability.evidence: Small focused methods e.g. app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:286 throttleKey(), app/Http/Controllers/Auth/EmailVerificationController.php:52 notice()/68 verify()/90 send(); clear names and PHPDoc on public methods; consistent {{ }} escaping, no dead code

requirements.evidence: Login app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:258-275 (5-attempt throttle, auth.failed/auth.throttle, session()->regenerate(), redirectIntended(route('home'))); Register app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:333-358 (transliterate register|ip key, Password::defaults(), Registered event, login+regenerate); PasswordResetController.php:198-203 rotates remember_token and fires PasswordReset; EmailVerificationController.php:71-75 hash_equals id+hash 403 check; routes/web.php:944-967 all named routes with throttle:6,1 and signed; lang/pt_BR/ui.php:545-550 Entrar/Senha/Esqueceu a senha?

scope.evidence: Diff touches only auth: .env.example, config/app.php locale default, phpunit.xml locale pins, Livewire Auth x2, controllers x3, routes/web.php, required views, lang/en|pt_BR/ui.php, plus in-scope docs sync CHANGELOG.md and docs/business-rules.md; no SCSS/JS, Docker, mail theme or unrelated refactors

security.evidence: Server-side $this->validate()/$request->validate() everywhere; EmailVerificationController.php:71 abort_unless hash_equals id and sha1(email) 403 plus signed+throttle:6,1 in routes/web.php:962-964; forgot-password always returns passwords.sent at PasswordResetController.php:173; {{ }} escaping in all views; #[Fillable(['name','email','password'])] on User; rate limits on login/register/forgot/verify; no secrets in public props beyond client-supplied password

simplicity.evidence: Reuses Password::broker()->sendResetLink/reset, RateLimiter, Password::defaults() once in AppServiceProvider.php:418, named routes and one shared x-form-field/x-layouts.app; no service layers or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: New Pest suites tests/Feature/Auth/LoginTest.php (rate-limit, auth.failed, remember cookie, auth-switch guard), RegisterTest.php (confirmed, defaults, unique, 5-attempt throttle, auth-switch), ResetPasswordTest.php (single name="email", remember_token rotation, PasswordReset event), EmailVerificationTest.php (tampered-id 403, unsigned 403, resend throttle), plus LocalizationTest.php and ViewConventionsTest.php

review.summary: Implements the full pt-BR session auth flow (Livewire login/register, logout, home behind auth+verified, throttled forgot/reset, signed own-account-only verification) with locale pins and translation files. Coverage is thorough including failure, throttle, unauthorized-call and tamper tests; the only nit is Register using rules() instead of the #[Validate] attribute pattern, so approve with nits.
